headline: Poland Receives 33 bn zł from RRP. It's the Penultimate Payment
summary: The European Commission paid Poland €7.9 billion, about 33 billion zł, under the National Recovery Plan (KPO). The payment responds to Poland's penultimate payment request, while the government has submitted its final request.
why: EU recovery funds finance public investment and reforms in member states, and their disbursement affects government budgets and growth outlooks.
